uv: TEXT ATLAS, not world-scale (as jp_m_decal_sumi_text): map a face onto one cell's rectangle ("cells": u0, v0, u1, v1 with v down), keeping the cell's aspect; 1024 px = 1 m. Lay the decal 2-3 mm off the surface; never in Geometry/View/Fire. Text runs top to bottom, columns right to left.
grain: brush strokes (Yuji Syuku kanji, Yuji Hentaigana Akebono kana)
used_on: Ink text for the life layer (charms, calendar, lanterns, ledgers, casks)
normal_convention: DirectX (green = down), like the library; make_textures.GREEN_DX flips all
render: _ca alpha = coverage; renderFlags NoZWrite (jp_m_wall_grime / vanilla decal pattern). RGB is the material colour everywhere, so the palette mean is meaningful.
note: The life layer's ink: paper charms, the Kyoho 15 (1730) calendar, lantern shop names and crests, the ledger cover, a sake-cask mark. Fonts: SIL OFL 1.1, Yuji Project Authors. Nothing emissive.

ofuda_jingu.for: jp_f_ofuda: Ise Jingu taima (the most widely held house charm)
